scope: Exact-byte artifact reuse within one scan process, including bounded S3 batches and preencoded report chunks
new_behavior: Identical public artifact bytes reuse references within a batch and across same-scan checkpoints.
Batch-local pending references are promoted to the owner cache only after all uploads succeed.
A cached manifest still flushes and checks all pending dependencies before returning.
Producer/deletion operations serialize per scan while the existing bounded upload pool overlaps I/O.
Preencoded JSON chunks use the same exact-byte cache; local/custom adapter policy is preserved.

bounds.cache_contents: Only kind, content type, SHA256 and generated references; no raw bodies or secret evidence

interpretation: The large compact fixture has10000findings/resources and3checkpoints: two unchanged inventories then one changed evidence value; publication sequence changes each time.
20ms delay is simulated per PUT. Uploads513→137 and compressed transfer23.32MB→10.58MB. This is publication performance, not whole-scan speed.

The final6-repeat zero-delay control shows5.38% lower summed median CPU and4.58% lower wall time. The first4-repeat control had noisy first-checkpoint CPU and7.19% higher summed CPU; retained in full here rather than omitted.
The1000-finding zero-delay control costs~4.6ms more CPU on first publication and~1.35ms more across all3; fewer network requests remain the benefit for small reports.
Traced allocation peaks are essentially unchanged (~117.2MB for large fixture), with roughly tens of KiB variation; no RSS or RAM reduction is claimed. Persistent reference metadata remains bounded.
Synthetic coverage rows include duplicates even within the first checkpoint. Actual savings depend on how much serialized public content repeats.
No live cloud calls, production deployment, cloud-data freshness change or cross-scan response cache.

large_20ms.limitations: Synthetic complete report checkpoints; simulated S3 latency and temporary file transport. Catalog initialization, fixture construction, parity resolution and cleanup are outside timing. Four interleaved runs per variant; separate tracemalloc run is not process RSS. Includes all sanitization, grouping, Markdown, native expansion, serialization and compression. Does not measure whole-scan speed or live cloud performance.
